outline:
當企業在邁向資訊化與自動化的同時，智慧生產工程師需考量如何整合智慧製造與精實生產。本課程的目標在幫助學生瞭解智慧製造在工廠上的應用，學習建構所謂精實導向的企業。
Since business are moving toward information and automation, smart production engineers need to consider how to integrate smart manufacturing and lean production. The goal of this course is to help students understand the application of smart manufacturing in the factory and to learn to build a so-called lean-oriented enterprise.
schedule:
Week 1 Introduction

Week 2 競爭力、策略和生產力於智慧製造的應用
/Competitiveness, Strategy, and Productivity

Week 3 預測於智慧製造的應用/Forecasting

Week 4 智慧製造對產品與服務設計的影響/Product and Service Design

Week 5 產品與服務之策略性產能規劃/
Strategic Capacity Planning for Products and Services

Week 6 製程選擇與設施佈置/Process Selection and Facilities Layout

Week 7 工作設計與衡量/Work Design and Measurement

Week 8 地點規劃與分析/Location Planning and Analysis

Week 9 Midterm Exam

Week 10 品質管理/ Management of Quality

Week 11 品質管制/ Quality Control

Week 12 總體規劃與主排程/ Aggregate Planning and Master Scheduling

Week 13 MRP and ERP

Week 14 存貨管理/Inventory Management

Week 15 JIT與精實作業/ JIT and Lean Operations

Week 16 供應鏈管理/ Supply Chain Management

Week 17 排程/Scheduling

Week 18 Final exam
scorePolicy:
期中考(30%) [以觀念為主]
期末考(30%) [以觀念為主]
課堂報告(15%) [針對16項主題，擇一報告，並以智慧化應用為主題擴充]
期末案例報告(20%) [依據學期所學內容，自行選取一可能案例作分享與報告]
讀書心得報告(5%) [智慧化相關書籍，1,000字心得]
